reason: Two registered GTM tools have concrete v2 account/container handlers; shared server also registers three WhatConverts and two GA4 tools.
exposure: All seven tools are always listed; execution requires product credentials. Create-only writes require literal boolean confirmed:true, otherwise local preview; shared process-local cap is 10 successful tool writes per rolling hour.
limitations: Static source extraction; no live API calls or credential-dependent behavior verified.
List and duplicate-check handlers do not paginate Google results or WhatConverts results beyond accounts_per_page=250, so lists and duplicate guards may be incomplete.

Schemas preserve the exposed literals; handlers impose additional validation absent from JSON Schema: trimmed nonempty strings (generally <=200 characters), GTM account ID <=32 characters and digits only, Analytics parent accounts/<digits>, HTTPS URL <=2048 characters, and positive integer WhatConverts account ID.

GA4 creation is two sequential API writes without rollback; if stream creation fails, the property remains and the successful-write cap is not incremented. The process-local cap is checked before writes and has no concurrent reservation.

tools.name: wc_list_accounts
tools.description: Read-only — list all WhatConverts agency accounts and their profiles (ids + names).
tools.behavior: WhatConverts: retrieves up to 250 agency accounts and their embedded profiles.

tools.name: wc_create_account
tools.description: ⚠️ MUTATING — Create a WhatConverts account (one per client, matching the agency convention). Refuses if an account with the same name exists. Dry-run by default.

confirmed.description: Must be true to execute. Defaults to false (dry run).

tools.behavior: WhatConverts: previews by default; confirmed true checks the shared write cap and case-insensitive duplicate account name before posting an account without a profile.

tools.name: wc_create_profile
tools.description: ⚠️ MUTATING — Create a profile inside an existing WhatConverts account. Refuses if a profile with the same name exists anywhere in the agency (guards against the duplicate/wrong-parent mistake). Dry-run by default.

confirmed.description: Must be true to execute. Defaults to false (dry run).

tools.behavior: WhatConverts: previews by default; confirmed true checks the shared write cap, parent presence and agency-wide duplicate profile name before posting a profile.

tools.name: ga4_list_properties
tools.description: Read-only — list GA4 accounts and their properties (names + ids + measurement streams).
tools.behavior: Google Analytics 4: lists accounts, properties and data streams with measurement IDs.

tools.name: ga4_create_property
tools.description: ⚠️ MUTATING — Create a GA4 property under an existing Analytics account, plus a web data stream (returns the G- measurement ID). Refuses on duplicate display name. Dry-run by default.

website_url.description: https:// URL for the web data stream.

time_zone.description: IANA tz. Defaults to GA4_DEFAULT_TIME_ZONE env, else UTC.

confirmed.description: Must be true to execute. Defaults to false (dry run).

tools.behavior: Google Analytics 4: previews by default; confirmed true checks the shared write cap and case-insensitive duplicate name before sequentially creating a USD property and HTTPS web stream.

tools.name: gtm_list_containers
tools.description: Read-only — list GTM accounts and their containers (names + public GTM-XXXX ids).
tools.behavior: Lists GTM accounts and containers using Google Tag Manager v2, returning account IDs, container IDs, public IDs and names.

tools.name: gtm_create_container
tools.description: ⚠️ MUTATING — Create a web container in an existing GTM account. Returns the GTM-XXXX id. Refuses on duplicate name. Does NOT publish anything. Dry-run by default.

confirmed.description: Must be true to execute. Defaults to false (dry run).

tools.behavior: Validates a numeric account ID and nonempty name, previews by default, and only with confirmed true checks the shared write cap and duplicate name before creating a web container without publishing.

review.summary: Creates tracking workspaces and ensures GA4 event tags with create-only and dry-run checks.
